title: WMATA - Washington DC Metro Signs
description: Washington DC Metro inspired station signs and transit decorations for realistic Minecraft subway and city builds.
body:
# WMATA - Washington DC Metro Signs

Bring the iconic look of the **Washington Metro** into Minecraft with a detailed collection of WMATA-inspired station signs and transit decorations.

This mod adds decorative subway and metro signage inspired by the visual style of the **Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority / WMATA Metrorail** system, perfect for realistic underground stations, city builds, transit hubs, roleplay servers, and modern urban Minecraft worlds.

---

## Features

- WMATA-inspired Washington Metro station signs
- Decorative blocks based on real Metrorail signage style
- Station signs inspired by Washington DC Metro wayfinding
- Line-color design inspired by the Red, Orange, Silver, Blue, Yellow, and Green lines
- Great for realistic metro stations, platforms, tunnels, entrances, and transport hubs
- Perfect for Minecraft city builders, map creators, and roleplay servers
- Clean, modern, and recognizable transit-style decoration
- Designed to bring an authentic Washington Metro atmosphere into your Minecraft world

---

## Best Used For

- Washington DC themed maps
- Metro and subway station builds
- Modern city projects
- Underground transit systems
- Train stations and transport hubs
- Roleplay servers
- Urban infrastructure builds
- Public transportation decorations

## Compatibility

This mod is designed for Minecraft Java Edition and can be used in creative builds, city maps, subway projects, and multiplayer servers.

Please check the available versions on this Modrinth page before downloading.

---

## About This Mod

**WMATA - Washington DC Metro Signs** is part of the MNetwork Transit Signs collection.

The goal of this project is to give Minecraft builders a realistic set of transit-themed decorative blocks inspired by real metro systems from the United States.

Whether you are building a detailed Washington DC map, a fictional metro network, a large urban server, or a modern underground station, this mod gives you the signage assets needed to make your transit system feel more authentic and immersive.

---

## Notes

This is a fan-made Minecraft mod inspired by Washington Metro / WMATA-style transit signage.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to the Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority / WMATA.

All signs are created as decorative Minecraft content for builders and transit-themed projects.
